**Proposal Details**

To have the rights to manage primarily the Twitter account for Edgeware DAO and other willing contributions for Edgeware DAO.

**About me:**

My name is C. Gagan Babu, 22, Computer Science Engineer.
I have been part of the Edgeware DAO community since December 2021, And have been attending Discord calls since then, engaging with the community members and Contributors. 
Figured I can do a good job managing the socials as I love writing and communicating with new people. The complete relationship part is in progress. But I am sure I can bridge the disconnect.
I would also like to use my expertise in coding and contribute my skills in the future when the opportunity arises.
Looking forward to hosting various events and competitions as well.

I have been running the Twitter account of Edgeware DAO for the past 4 months, Under the guidance of Thom and Shankar for the first 2 months.
- Push the content out as quickly as possible with good phrasing.
- Run the account professionally but at the same time with a casual touch depending on the current trend to gain engagement.
- Create Infographics.
